panel_rule: Display at least three comparator countries and include at least one European and one Asian peer whenever a matched official series exists. Country membership may vary by lane; missing observations remain missing.
common_basis_rule: Prefer calendar-year general-government measures, percent of GDP or PPP per person, and the same source vintage. Never compare a United States federal-only function directly with a peer all-government total.

observed_batches.coverage: 2022 general-government COFOG divisions GF01-GF10 for ten observed countries plus explicit Canadian and United States GF05 missingness
IMF fills Canada's ten OECD-missing cells; Korea stays OECD and United States GF05 stays missing
2022 tax revenue, tax mix, total revenue, overall and primary balances, and gross and net debt for the global panel
2022 direct general-government D.41 interest payable for eleven core peers, expressed as percent GDP and percent revenue; Singapore remains missing
2022 general-government net interest spending percent GDP for eleven core peers; Singapore remains missing
2022Q4 general-government short-term original-maturity debt for ten peers and long-term-original debt due within one year for six peers
2022 public old-age/survivors and family-benefit totals, cash, and services for seven countries with five explicit gaps
modeled gross and net mandatory-scheme replacement rates for an average-earning male entrant in all eleven core peers
actual older-person relative poverty with explicit 2020-2024 country years and child relative poverty centered on 2021 for eleven peers

official_source_families: OECD Health Statistics and System of Health Accounts
lanes.boundary: Compare whole health systems; Medicare is not equivalent to another country's national system.
Public spending alone is incomplete where mandatory occupational or funded pensions are large.
Threat exposure, alliances, conscription, and procurement cycles prevent an automatic efficient-spending target.

official_source_families: OECD Social Expenditure Database and Family Database
lanes.boundary: Cash, in-kind services, refundable credits, parental leave, and housing support must be displayed separately.

official_source_families: IMF Government Finance Statistics and Fiscal Monitor
lanes.boundary: Peer averages are context, not required tax, deficit, or debt targets; federal receipts are not all-government revenue.
Gross Treasury interest is not consolidated general-government interest; assets, inflation, currency, maturity, and central-bank holdings matter.

official_source_families: National audit institutions and program statistical releases
European Court of Auditors for EU-budget context only
lanes.boundary: There is no harmonized international improper-payment or fraud rate. Do not rank raw findings or treat error as fraud or recoverable savings.

official_source_families: National veterans ministries and military pension accounts
lanes.boundary: Conflict history, conscription, eligibility, dependent coverage, pensions, and health-system placement differ too much for a naive spending rank.

official_source_families: OECD International Transport Forum infrastructure investment
lanes.boundary: Match all government levels, user-financed investment, capital versus maintenance, geography, network age, and modal mix.

official_source_families: OECD Education at a Glance and PISA
lanes.boundary: The United States federal function is only part of national education and workforce spending; PISA is not a causal efficiency measure.
Hazard and exposure dominate annual spending. Use multiyear, hazard-specific, exposure-normalized comparisons rather than one-year relief outlays.

official_source_families: Council of Europe CEPEJ and SPACE
lanes.boundary: Legal systems, offense definitions, reporting, due-process protections, and government scope differ; avoid raw recorded-crime rankings.

official_source_families: OECD Main Science and Technology Indicators
lanes.boundary: Science, energy, and environment remain separate. Total R&D includes business spending and energy prices embed different taxes and subsidies.

official_source_families: OECD Producer and Consumer Support Estimates
lanes.boundary: Market-price support is not budget expenditure; EU common agricultural policy treatment and nutrition-program exclusions must be explicit.
ODA is only one component; diplomacy, export finance, military aid, arms sales, and financial instruments cannot be added without reconciliation.

claim_guardrails.unlock_rule: A lane-specific result requires captured official source bytes, source metadata and checksum, matched year/unit/perimeter, missingness disclosure, comparability review, metric-specific application of the international comparator target rubric, and separate service or outcome interpretation before its claim gate can change.
